items.description: A major hotel and hospitality landmark in Gaborone. It is part of the capital's tourism and business scene.
A leading hospital in Gaborone and one of Botswana's key health facilities. It is an important public service landmark.
The University of Botswana's admin block is part of the main campus in Gaborone. It is a central academic building.
The central bank building in Gaborone is a key financial landmark. It represents the country's monetary authority.
Francistown Railway Station is a historic transport landmark in northern Botswana. It reflects the city's rail connection and trade role.
A statue in Gaborone honoring Botswana's first president, Seretse Khama. It is a public symbol of the country's modern history.
The Tuli Block is a major cattle-farming area along Botswana's eastern borderlands. It is one of the country's best-known agricultural zones.
The Gaborone Botanical Garden is a green public space for learning and recreation. It is a family-friendly city stop with native plants.
Tsodilo Hills are rocky hills rising above the Kalahari in northwestern Botswana. They are also linked to ancient rock art and long human use.
The Shashe River is a seasonal river in eastern Botswana. It feeds part of the Limpopo drainage system.
The Tati River forms part of the drainage network around Francistown. It has shaped settlement and mining areas in the northeast.
The Moshaweng River is a smaller seasonal river in southeastern Botswana. It contributes to local drainage and valley landscapes.
